summary: CLI and MCP test mains clear operator tokens and sandbox directories.
reason: testenv.RunSandboxed clears HOME/XDG and per-CLI dir overrides but not the auth token, so an operator-exported token leaked into package tests and made TestDoctorCacheRowsUseActualResourceCounts fail order-dependently. Upstream should add the CLI's auth env vars to testenv clearedVars. Each cli test isolation also resets credential-derived process-global database scope so earlier token-bearing tests cannot redirect later fixtures. Clear READWISE_BASE_URL in testenv as well: the gate exports loopback and credential-origin tests must keep their own fixture server identity.
reapply: In internal/cli/root_test.go TestMain, unset READWISE_API_TOKEN before os.Exit(testenv.RunSandboxed(m)).
